name: User Message Color
description: Highlights user messages by recoloring the dark-theme userMessageBackground from grey rgb(55, 55, 55) to blue-600 rgb(37, 99,235). Patches both dark-theme variants (standard + daltonized) in the main CJS module. Same-length string-literal swap, no offset breakage.

provenance.author: gabinfay
provenance.derived_by: anchored against pristine 2.1.158 using 2.1.88 source ref

operations.rationale: Standard dark theme: userMessageBackground 'rgb(55, 55, 55)' -> 'rgb(37, 99,235)'. Distinguished from the daltonized variant by the preceding cyan_FOR_SUBAGENTS_ONLY:"rgb(8,145,178)" token. Backref \g<1>/\g<2> preserve churned minified context; only the 15-byte rgb literal changes.

Daltonized (colorblind) dark theme: userMessageBackground 'rgb(55, 55, 55)' -> 'rgb(37, 99,235)'. Distinguished from the standard dark variant by the preceding cyan_FOR_SUBAGENTS_ONLY:"rgb(102,204,204)" token. Backref \g<1>/\g<2> preserve churned context; only the 15-byte rgb literal changes.
